claim_text: Vitamin K can interact with vitamin K antagonist anticoagulants such as warfarin; consistent vitamin K intake and prescriber-guided changes are important, and users should not start or stop vitamin K supplements independently.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsafe supplementation and ensure clinical context is considered.

population.other_context: People taking vitamin K supplements and regular medication, especially vitamin K antagonist anticoagulants.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin K Health Professional Fact Sheet describes the clinically important interaction with warfarin and the importance of consistent intake.
limitations: Do not generalize the interaction to all anticoagulants; medication-specific advice requires clinician/pharmacist review.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
